milestone: One reproducible current source revision proves the frozen theorem, with sorry proofs only for exact known published theorems.

metric.name: Conservative evidence-backed acceptance-checklist completion floor
metric.formula: (22 retired original admissions + 8 historically accepted wrappers) / (121 actual original admissions + 8 definition validations + 4 final gates)
metric.numerator_boundary: Historical accepted work whose source treatment remains preserved, plus any later fully evidenced original acceptance units. There are currently no newly accepted complete units from the partial checks.

denominator_basis.publication_audit_policy: Every original obligation includes the approval of all admitted dependencies it uses. Shared leaf reviews may serve several obligations but are not additional numerator/denominator units. Moving or splitting an admission never earns credit by itself.
denominator_basis.scope_revision_policy: Attach discovered subtasks to the governing original obligation, definition validation, or final gate. Change the fixed denominator only by an explicit recorded scope revision.
denominator_basis.supersedes: The earlier provisional 153-unit suggestion in TARGET_INTEGRATION.md double-counted 50 leaf reviews and is superseded by this 133-unit ledger.

acceptance_rule.original_obligation: Either recorded sound retirement as unused, or an implementation preserving the required statement, exact approval of admitted dependencies, proved nondefinitional project translations, and matching changed-module/reverse-dependency evidence. Current whole-graph certification is also required at GATE-02.
acceptance_rule.definitions: All eight named semantic validations remain separate; preserving identical operational definitions is not itself a proof that they match standard notions.
acceptance_rule.historical_boundary: The 22 Step 3a retirements and 8 Step 3b wrappers are credited from their recovered stage-acceptance records and current static preservation. This is not a claim that the whole current graph has been built.
acceptance_rule.status_update_rule: Promote an individual unit only when its evidence meets the rule; do not infer closure from namespace, sorry count, helper compilation, or an unverified completion announcement.

source_snapshot.aggregate_convention: SHA256 of sorted lines filename + space + file SHA256 + newline; current source only.

final_gates.name: Exact frozen theorem endpoint
final_gates.acceptance_requirement: A compiled unconditional theorem with the unchanged frozen hypotheses and both conclusions, including the actual positive metric Wolf homothety; no unproved PositiveQKSimpleConnectedness parameter.
final_gates.partial_progress: Frozen specification preserved and importable statement compiled. Target assembly is conditional, and its full dependency graph is not yet accepted.

final_gates.name: Dependency-complete current compilation
final_gates.acceptance_requirement: All required current modules and reverse dependencies compile with exact source/dependency/runtime receipts, including the final target.
final_gates.partial_progress: Four modules passed independent current-source CI; several larger candidates passed baseline-interface diagnostics. The full current graph remains open.

final_gates.name: Exhaustive final transitive admission audit
final_gates.acceptance_requirement: Native final-theorem dependencies and every source admission agree with the exact published-theorem allowlist; no novel proof, composite application, transport, or hidden extra assumption remains admitted.
final_gates.partial_progress: Static inventories and selected exact-source comparisons exist. A topology transport has an axiom print containing no sorryAx. The final theorem trust audit remains open.

final_gates.name: Reproducible locked milestone checkpoint
final_gates.acceptance_requirement: One final source revision packages the frozen specification, source and runtime locks, accepted-unit evidence, whole-graph build receipts, and final trust-audit result in a reproducible checkpoint.
final_gates.partial_progress: Runtime, source-preserving recovery, replay tooling, and targeted CI evidence exist. They are not a completed final milestone checkpoint.

partial_progress_no_additional_credit.description: Importable frozen statement and actual homothety/topology transports compiled on current dependencies, independently in CI.

Generic split nilpotent-thickening topology proved in LSNilpotentTopology and compiled on current dependencies. Its project application in LSHomVelocity passed a baseline-interface diagnostic. Native axiom inspection of the actual project theorem contains no sorryAx.

The repaired determinant module RecompileBasePart05A and all its current ancestors passed fresh stock-compiler CI. Its later reverse-dependency acceptance remains blocked at Part07; no whole original unit is promoted.

The actual first-jet proof in LSFirstJetEmbedding and LSFirstJetEmbeddingGeometry, and its public application in LSClassicalReduction, all passed pinned native diagnostics against recovered interfaces. Full current dependency and inherited-admission acceptance remain open. The native recursive audit finds exactly one inherited generic pullback-rank admission and excludes old firstjet or determinant dependencies; explicit primary references cover the actual rank-one use.

Three Step3f leaf statements are eligible direct published directions after primary-source comparison. The cotangent-Hom bijection still needs its generic canonical-map/conormal bridge. Publication eligibility alone does not close these original obligations.

No-sorry source assembly reaches the exact frozen endpoint conditionally on PositiveQKSimpleConnectedness. No admitted proof of that full project statement was introduced, and the complete assembly is not yet compiled.
New point-1 proof translations and native diagnostics; full edited graph and exact published boundary remain unaccepted.
